COMMON / plain iron, single rule, square corner joints

Portrait inlay / rank and figure emblems

text.tspan: A campaign soldier drills with spear and shield, keeps
equipment ready, and holds position beside the rest of the
unit. Dependable service under orders lays the foundation
for the judgment and responsibility of command.
